children: Brittain, who took over as chair in January 2023, purchased the shares on Wednesday at an average price of 732.29p each, for a total value of £73,229.
Following the transaction, Brittain holds a beneficial interest in 60,000 ordinary Dunelm shares.
As of 1540 BST, Dunelm shares were up 3.75% at 761.50p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
